pokedexEntries.di: It can learn and speak human words. If they gather, they all learn the same saying.

pokedexEntries.prl: It keeps rhythm by flicking its tail feathers like a metronome. It imitates human speech.

pokedexEntries.pt: Its tongue is just like a human’s. As a result, it can cleverly mimic human speech.

pokedexEntries.hgss: It mimics the cries of other Pokémon to trick them into thinking it’s one of them. This way they won’t attack it.
